items.title: The Anti-AI ETF Is Here, and Its Biggest Holdings Are Engines, Trucks and Air Conditioners
items.summary: A new ETF built on diesel engines, truck fleets, and air conditioners is pitching itself as a refuge from software-heavy portfolios, but its biggest holding may already be cashing in on the very trend it claims to avoid.

items.title: Big Manufacturers Find New Demand in Equipping AI Data Centers
items.summary: Companies such as Caterpillar and Cummins are pivoting to feed a booming market for once-prosaic machinery.

items.title: How fast can the U.S. build data centers amid labour concerns?
items.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. could increase annual data center construction from 12 gigawatts in 2026 to 35 GW by 2030, but shortages of specialised mechanical, electrical and plumbing workers will set the industry’s speed limit, according to Bernstein analysts.

items.title: Bloom Energy Stock Carries A Multiple Built On Quarters It Has Outgrown
items.summary: The fuel cell maker's earnings multiple is measured on a trailing year, while the guidance management has raised describes a far bigger business. That mismatch moves the buy decision onto delivery rather than demand.

items.title: Caterpillar's Falling Multiple Rests On Margin, Not Its Backlog
items.summary: Consensus already expects the revenue boom to fade, leaving margin to do much of the work of bringing the multiple down.

items.title: 3 Large-Cap Stocks We Find Risky
items.summary: Large-cap stocks are known for their staying power and ability to weather market storms better than smaller competitors. However, their sheer size makes it more challenging to maintain high growth rates as they’ve already captured significant portions of their markets.

items.title: 5 Revealing Analyst Questions From Cummins’s Q2 Earnings Call

Management highlighted surging power generation demand—especially from data centers—as a significant driver, with CEO Jennifer Rumsey emphasizing expanded capacity and a major agreement with a global hyperscaler.
